title: Bad Born Blood
tagline: An orphan cadet gives the Empire his eye, and never flinches.
description: The Empire takes children and turns them into weapons. Number thirty-two is Luca, a lower-city orphan in the Imperial Guard, where broken parts get swapped for titanium and loyalty is the only thing that can't be replaced. Set in the RF Online universe, on the planet Novus.
credits: Art: D-Park · Story: Jinuri (지누리) · Adaptation: Ho Bak-sae (호박새) · Original novel: Baeksu Noble (백수귀족) · Produced by REDICE Studio

parts.summary: Luca trains alongside a noble heir who wants to be his friend, learns from a teacher nobody can read, and finds that the people above him are painting a bigger picture. Episodes 1 to 48.
